# Docs Layout

This example uses the real source-owned MoyaForge UI component. It does not create a second component implementation or application router.

## Installation

Install `docs-layout` from the MoyaForge registry to copy the selected component source and CSS into your application.

[All UI components](/ui)

## Usage

```tsx
<DocsLayout
  title="Example documentation"
  pages={[{ url: "/ui", title: "Overview" }]}
  currentUrl="/ui"
  header={<strong>Documentation preview</strong>}
  sidebar={null}
  outline={null}
>
  <p>Customizable layout content</p>
</DocsLayout>
```

### Collapsible outline

Set `toc.collapsible` to enable native HTML `<details>` disclosure, and
`toc.defaultOpen` to control its initial state. No React disclosure state or
JavaScript click handler is required. Custom `outline` and `sidebar` slots
continue to replace the defaults.

## Styling

Use the documented `DocsLayout` styles and `toc` settings to customize layout and outline presentation.
